title: Doctor Workspace
subtitle: Encounter, prescribing, lab ordering and patient history in one clinical view

overview.lead: The Doctor Workspace is the clinician's cockpit. A live queue feeds patients in; selecting one opens a focused encounter where the doctor prescribes against the live formulary, orders lab tests (which auto-bill and flow to the lab), and reviews prior visits and results — including abnormal and critical lab values surfaced inline. Everything the doctor does updates the same patient record the rest of the clinic works from.
highlights: Live queue — pick a patient and the encounter opens in context
Prescribe against the live formulary with dosage and quantity
Order lab tests that auto-bill the visit and reach the lab instantly
Lab results read back inline with abnormal / critical flags
Full patient history — prior visits, prescriptions and results
Every action writes to the shared patient record

queue.title: Live patient queue
queue.description: The workspace opens to the doctor's own live queue, split by OPD and Emergency. Selecting a patient loads their encounter into the workspace — one click from waiting-room to clinical work, with the queue staying visible for flow.
bullets: Doctor's own queue, OPD / Emergency split
Real-time — updates as reception checks patients in
One click selects the patient and opens the encounter
Queue stays in view alongside the clinical tabs
queue.impact: The doctor moves from one patient to the next without leaving the screen.

labs.title: Lab orders & results read-back
labs.description: From the encounter the doctor orders lab tests in a click — and those orders both bill the visit and appear instantly on the lab bench. Crucially, results read back here inline, with abnormal and critical values flagged, so the ordering doctor sees a dangerous result without hunting for a report.
bullets: Order one or more tests against the visit
Orders auto-bill the patient and reach the lab immediately
Results read back inline with value, unit and reference range
Abnormal and critical values clearly flagged
Closes the loop between doctor and laboratory
labs.impact: Patient safety: the doctor who ordered the test is the one who sees the critical result.

medicines.title: Prescribing
medicines.description: The doctor builds a prescription against the live pharmacy formulary — the same catalogue and stock the pharmacy dispenses from — with dosage and quantity per item. The prescription flows to the pharmacy, so what's prescribed is exactly what can be dispensed and billed.
bullets: Prescribe from the live formulary (same stock as pharmacy)
Prescription flows straight to the pharmacy counter
medicines.impact: No transcription gap between what's prescribed and what's dispensed.

history.title: Patient history
history.description: Every prior visit, prescription and lab result for the patient is on hand in the encounter, so the doctor makes decisions with the full picture rather than a fresh, blank chart each time.
bullets: Prior visits with status and outcome
All from the shared patient record
history.impact: Decisions are made with the whole history, not a blank page.

closing.lead: One clinical view that closes every loop
points: Lab orders auto-bill and return results inline — with critical values flagged.
Prescriptions flow to the same pharmacy stock they'll be dispensed from.
The queue, encounter and history are one continuous workflow.
Every figure here is live from the running system on realistic demo data.
